pages.title: Desktop: working, no title bars
pages.caption: The shell draws the frame; apps tile inside with no title bars. The arm is the window list (focused = gold). The top bar holds pages, the focused window’s full title and the clock. Black apps get a dim 2 px Hyprland border; the focused one gets gold.

pages.title: Low urgency: a readout
pages.caption: A low-urgency message becomes one more readout segment in the bottom bar and leaves after 4 s. No card, no sound.

pages.title: Normal: the comms block grows out
pages.caption: The arm's comms block grows across the work area. Black type on the block's colour, actions as black pills, a pill end where it stops. It is part of the frame, not a window.

pages.title: After 7 s: folded into the arm
pages.caption: Unread messages fold back into one counted block under the window list. Clicking it would grow the history out the same way.

pages.title: Critical: the frame goes red
pages.caption: Critical turns the whole frame to alert red and the block stays out until acknowledged. The top bar says what is wrong.

pages.title: Extension: LCARS reading view
pages.caption: What a content script could do to an article: contents from the page's headings, LCARS headings and code boxes, body kept in a readable face. The origin shows in the shell's top bar, which a page cannot fake.

pages.title: Desktop: Super+Tab
pages.caption: Every window on every page and screen, most recent first. The page or screen sits in the small block; the title gets the width.

pages.title: Desktop: laptop and tablet
pages.caption: Each screen gets its own frame and window list. Only the laptop shows the clock and readouts, so nothing is shown twice.

pages.title: Desktop: 1280×800
pages.caption: Same frame on a smaller screen. The arm and bars shrink; the Files tile drops its size column.

pages.title: A, Console
pages.caption: One elbow. Hosts stacked in the left arm; the transfer runs along the bottom elbow. Closest to the on-screen LCARS look.

pages.title: B, Split
pages.caption: TNG double frame. Top half: where you are (hosts, path, transfer). Bottom half: the list, with actions and readouts in the arm. Costs about a quarter of the height.

pages.title: C, PADD
pages.caption: No elbows. Clickable path segments, Miller columns, hosts in a bottom strip. Most usable, least like the show.

pages.title: A, hosts overflow open
pages.caption: Hosts that do not fit open in a menu at window level. Check the Host key changed warning on kuro.

pages.title: A, narrow, Hosts menu
pages.caption: At 460 px the arm cannot hold labels, so all hosts move into one Hosts pill.

pages.title: B, narrow, More menu
pages.caption: Hosts row keeps one host and moves four into More.

pages.title: C, narrow, Hosts menu
pages.caption: Bottom strip folds every host into Hosts; the menu opens upward.

pages.title: A, empty folder
pages.caption: Empty state: a plain sentence and the next actions.

pages.title: B, empty folder
pages.caption: Same empty state inside the split frame.

pages.title: C, empty folder
pages.caption: Same empty state in the current column.
